critique: The HUD is clear but lacks visual flair; it feels flat and uninspired.
The health bar and score are readable, but the color contrast could be improved for better visibility.
The background appears empty, contributing to a lack of engagement in the visuals.
priorityFixes: Enhance the HUD design with more dynamic elements or animations to increase visual interest.
Increase the contrast of the health bar and score text against the background to improve readability.
Add background elements or effects to create a more immersive environment.
